mapper.sql: CASE WHEN u.user_id = 1 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = u.user_id AND r.role_key = 'admin' AND r.status = '0' AND r.del_flag = '0' ) THEN 'admin' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = u.user_id AND r.role_key = 'manager' AND r.status = '0' AND r.del_flag = '0' ) THEN 'manager' ELSE 'common' END
mapper.select:
SELECT u.user_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.email, u.phonenumber, u.avatar, u.status, u.del_flag, u.create_time, u.update_time, u.login_date, r.role_id, r.role_name, r.role_key, r.role_sort, r.data_scope, r.status AS role_status FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id AND r.del_flag = '0'
ORDER BY u.create_time DESC, u.user_id DESC, r.role_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (user_name, nick_name, email, phonenumber, avatar, password, status, pwd_update_date, create_by) VALUES (#{userName}, #{nickName}, #{email}, #{phonenumber}, COALESCE(#{avatar}, ''), #{password}, #{status}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{createBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET user_name = #{userName}, nick_name = #{nickName}, email = #{email}, phonenumber = #{phonenumber}, avatar = #{avatar}, status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND del_flag = '0'
UPDATE sys_user SET password = #{password}, pwd_update_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_role (role_name, role_key, role_sort, create_by) VALUES (#{name}, #{key}, #{sort}, 'user-management') ON CONFLICT (role_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_role WHERE role_key = #{key} AND status = '0' AND del_flag = '0' FOR SHARE
